8. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a lubricant comprising at least one selected from the group consisting of polyol ester and polyvinyl ether and a refrigerant comprising: from 1 to 99% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf); and from 1 to 99% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze), wherein said composition exhibits a Hazen color of about 200 or less as measured by ASHRAE test 97-2007 after a sealed glass tube comprising the composition is welded closed and placed in an oven at 200°C for 14 days, __wherein the lubricant is present in an amount of 1 to 500 parts by weight per 100 parts by weight of the refrigerant__.

9. (Currently Amended) The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester __selected from polyol esters__ obtained from polyols having a neopentyl backbone.

10. (Currently Amended) The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from a polyol selected from the group consisting of neopentyl glycol, trimethylolpropane, pentaerythritol and dipentaerythritol.

11. (Currently Amended) The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises a polyol ester obtained from a linear or branched carboxylic acid containing from 2 to 15 carbon atoms.

15. (Currently Amended) The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the lubricant comprises at least one PVE, wherein the at least one PVE is a copolymer of the following two units: Unit 1: __an ethyl vinyl ether unit__; Unit 2: __a t-butyl vinyl ether unit__.

16. (Currently Amended) The composition according to Claim 15, wherein the copolymer comprises from 50 to 95% by weight of Unit 1.
